post.summary: API-P7. Create a website booking. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header (8 to 128 printable characters) and a booking token from API-P10. Consumes the token and locks inventory. Pay at hotel confirms immediately. Online booking holds inventory and opens hosted checkout. Five requests per client per hour, on top of the per phone cap.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 8 to 128 printable ASCII characters. A retry with the same key and body replays the booking.

schema.description: 8 to 128 printable ASCII characters, no spaces.

200.description: Replay of the same key and body: the same reference, `manageUrl` null.

201.description: Booking confirmed for pay at hotel or awaiting online payment with a checkout URL. `manageUrl` is returned once.

post.summary: API-P8. Payment gateway callback. The body is the gateway's own payload (64 KB cap). The configured adapter verifies the raw bytes. A verified event is recorded once and answers `200`, also for duplicates and for events that change nothing. A failed verification answers `401` with no detail. No session and no CSRF.

post.summary: API-S9. Cancel a reservation. Unpaid (`reservations:cancel`): cancelled at once, freeing its units and coupon redemption; repeating it returns the cancelled reservation. Paid (`reservations:cancel-paid`, Manager and Admin only): records an approved staff request and starts a full refund; the reservation is cancelled only when the gateway confirms the refund (202). The guest hears "cancelled and refunded" only when `notifyGuest` is true and only after the refund succeeded.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The reservation version from the last read, formatted as "v<version>". Missing returns 428, an old one 412.

202.description: Paid reservation: the refund was started. The reservation is still confirmed and shows paymentStatus REFUND_PENDING (or the final state when the gateway answered at once).

post.summary: API-G2. Request cancellation before the deadline with the manage link token. G2 and G4 share ten attempts per client per hour. CANCELLATION_WINDOW_CLOSED includes context.deadline (UTC or null) and context.branch (name, slug, phone, email).

201.description: The open cancellation request. The booking is still confirmed.

default.description: Problem details. Codes: INTERNAL, UNAUTHENTICATED, PHONE_BLOCKED, CANCELLATION_WINDOW_CLOSED, CANCELLATION_REQUEST_EXISTS, INVALID_TRANSITION, VALIDATION, MALFORMED_JSON, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, RATE_LIMITED, TRY_AGAIN.

get.summary: API-G3. Reservations of a verified phone, newest first (`Authorization: Bearer` guest session token from API-P10).

default.description: Problem details. Codes: INTERNAL, PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED, PHONE_BLOCKED, RATE_LIMITED.

get.summary: API-G4. One reservation of a verified phone by reference. A reference that is not this phone's is a 404.

default.description: Problem details. Codes: INTERNAL, PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED, PHONE_BLOCKED, NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED.

post.summary: API-G4. Request cancellation for a reservation of the verified phone. An unknown or foreign reference returns 404. G2 and G4 share ten attempts per client per hour. CANCELLATION_WINDOW_CLOSED includes context.deadline (UTC or null) and context.branch (name, slug, phone, email).

201.description: The open cancellation request. The booking is still confirmed.

default.description: Problem details. Codes: INTERNAL, PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, PHONE_BLOCKED, CANCELLATION_WINDOW_CLOSED, CANCELLATION_REQUEST_EXISTS, INVALID_TRANSITION, VALIDATION, MALFORMED_JSON, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, RATE_LIMITED, TRY_AGAIN.

services.description: Omit to keep all services. Send the full list of selected kinds to add or remove services (an empty list removes all).
